summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-formatjs preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime zip from GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and then executes the sibling file math_init.js under Bun via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line file bearing a '// @bun @bun-cjs' header, containing a large numeric constant array plus a string-table rotation decoder (WV8StW shifting MmgoCP) and hex-mangled identifiers — a heavily obfuscated Bun-only bundle whose contents cannot be inspected as source. The package advertises itself as an ESLint configuration, which has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or for executing a large obfuscated payload at install time. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to run an opaque bundled payload during npm install evades scanners that only inspect Node-reachable code and is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
